surfaces.label: Legacy read bridge
surfaces.retirementCriteria: VITE_LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY_MODE=disabled survives one release window and legacy bridge telemetry shows no required daily-record bridge usage.
surfaces.nextAction: Keep the bridge import surface flat, then remove legacyRecordBridgeService from the daily-record read path after a clean disabled-mode release.

surfaces.label: Role aliases
surfaces.retirementCriteria: Two consecutive release snapshots show zero legacy viewer role aliases in production claims and config/roles, then write-back canonicalization can be removed.
surfaces.nextAction: Audit production role sources before deleting legacy viewer role compatibility from helpers, Firestore rules and Storage rules.

surfaces.label: Legacy clinical document hydration
surfaces.retirementCriteria: ClinicalDocumentRepository reads only current schema records for one release window and editor/import entrypoints no longer need legacy audit actor defaults.
surfaces.nextAction: Move application-level hydration calls behind a single clinical-document compatibility port before retiring schema v1 defaults.

surfaces.label: Legacy episode hydration
surfaces.retirementCriteria: All active patients carry canonical clinicalEpisodeId and document lookup no longer needs RUT/admission-date fallback keys.
surfaces.nextAction: Keep legacy episode-key parsing confined to patient-flow and clinical-document controllers; block UI-level ad hoc parsing.
